patterns.previous: Heavy Legs armor crafted from{j}materials such as the Red Violent Beast's crimson fur and extreme iron.{j}Its intricate metalwork is beautiful.

patterns.source: 大型の骨から強化される大剣。{j}重量で破壊力を得る骨大剣で、{j}これを扱えるなら一人前。
patterns.previous: A Great Sword upgraded from a large bone.{j}A bone Great Sword whose weight gives it destructive power;{j}if you can wield it, you are a full-fledged Hunter.

patterns.source: 訓練所で流した血と汗の結晶。{j}あの熱き日々が胸に去来する。{j}教官は元気にしてるだろうか。
patterns.previous: The crystallized blood and sweat shed at the Training School.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}I wonder if the Instructor is doing well.

patterns.source: 訓練所で流した血と汗の結晶。{j}あの熱き日々が胸に去来する。{j}たまには顔を出してあげよう。
patterns.previous: The crystallized blood and sweat shed at the Training School.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}I should drop by and show my face sometime.

patterns.source: 訓練所で流した血と汗の結晶。{j}あの熱き日々が胸に去来する。{j}流した涙も無駄にはならない。
patterns.previous: The crystallized blood and sweat shed at the Training School.{j}Those passionate days come flooding back.{j}Even the tears shed were not in vain.

patterns.source: 姿を見ることさえかなわない、{j}伝説の金竜銀竜の素材を用い{j}た双剣。火属性が非常に強力。
patterns.previous: Dual Blades whose form can never even be glimpsed,{j}forged from the materials of the legendary gold and silver dragons{j}. The Fire element is extremely powerful.

patterns.source: 最強の封龍剣をさらに超える{j}絶一門の最終兵器。全てが謎{j}の素材は太古の文明の名残か。
patterns.previous: Surpassing even the strongest Dragon Seal Sword{j}The ultimate weapon of the Absolute. Everything is a mystery.{j}Are these materials vestiges of an ancient civilization?

patterns.source: 名工がこしらえた宝石細工の{j}槍の強化版。美しい装飾のみ{j}ならず、実用性の高さも好評。
patterns.previous: An upgraded version of the jewel-worked{j}Lance fashioned by a master artisan. It is well regarded not{j}only for its beautiful ornamentation, but for its high practicality as well.

patterns.source: ギルドの研究と工房の技術向上{j}で、古の封龍剣が完全復活。{j}太古の叡智が手の中に。
patterns.previous: Through the Guild's research and the workshop's advances{j}, the ancient Sealed Dragon Sword is fully revived.{j}The wisdom of the ancients is now in your hands.

patterns.source: 師範代しか持つことを許され{j}ぬ高級稽古用太刀。先革から{j}柄まで、非の打ち所無き逸品。
patterns.previous: A high-grade training Long Sword that only assistant instructors are permitted{j}to possess. From the tip leather to the{j}hilt, it is a flawless masterpiece.

patterns.source: 伝説の家具職人の魂が宿った{j}大槌。大人気の肉球仕掛けの{j}詳細は、企業秘密らしい。
patterns.previous: A Hammer{j}imbued with the soul of a legendary furniture craftsman. The details of the wildly popular paw-pad gadget{j}are apparently a company secret.

patterns.source: 装飾を廃し、素材の持ち味を{j}最大限に引き出した大剣。{j}可能な限り加工した完成系。
patterns.previous: A Great Sword that forgoes decoration and draws out the material's inherent qualities{j}to the fullest.{j}A final form, processed to the greatest possible extent.

patterns.source: ダークランスの究極進化形。{j}内部構造を一から見直して、神{j}経毒の注入効率を大幅に向上。
patterns.previous: Dark Lance's ultimate evolved form. The{j}internal structure was redesigned from scratch, greatly improving the injection efficiency of divine{j}neurotoxin.

patterns.source: 黒角竜の素材で強化した剛鎚。{j}逞しい黒角竜の突進を思わせ{j}る破壊力は、まさに覇者の力。
patterns.previous: A mighty hammer reinforced with Black Diablos materials.{j}Its destructive power, reminiscent of{j}a Black Diablos's powerful charge, is truly the power of a conqueror.

patterns.source: 最先端の加工技術を結集し、{j}高い火属性と武器としての{j}威力を徹底追及した珠玉の槍。
patterns.previous: Bringing together cutting-edge processing technology,{j}High Fire element and, as a weapon,{j}A peerless lance that pursues raw power to the utmost.

patterns.source: 伝説の金竜銀竜の素材を用い{j}た双剣。武器となった今なお{j}熱さを感じる貴重な武器。
patterns.previous: Dual Blades made using{j}materials from the legendary Gold Dragon and Silver Dragon. Even now as a weapon,{j}it is a precious weapon that still feels hot.

patterns.source: 邪龍ミラボレアスを祀る神器。{j}〜大地の龍脈より命を受け{j}御神体の南門へ注ぐ者也〜
patterns.previous: A sacred treasure enshrining the Evil Dragon Fatalis.{j}~Granted its mission by the earth's dragon veins,{j}it pours into the South Gate of the divine body~

patterns.source: 極龍の力の象徴である磁力を{j}応用した片手剣。龍と麻痺の{j}双属性で、モンスターを狩れ。
patterns.previous: A Sword & Shield that applies the magnetism{j}symbolizing the Extreme Dragon's power. With its dual Dragon and Paralysis{j}attributes, hunt monsters.

patterns.previous: A Sword & Shield that applies the magnetism{j}symbolizing the Extreme Dragon's power. With its dual Dragon and Paralysis{j}attributes, mow down all fear!

patterns.source: 極龍の力の象徴である磁力を{j}応用した片手剣。龍と睡眠の{j}双属性で、畏れを薙ぎ払え！
patterns.previous: A Sword & Shield that applies the magnetism{j}symbolizing the Extreme Dragon's power. With its dual Dragon and Sleep{j}attributes, mow down all fear!

patterns.previous: Body armor modeled after the battle{j}garb of the gods who dwell in the Eastern paradise. A crystallization of Yama Tsukami{j}materials and legendary craft.

patterns.previous: Armor made from a special alloy{j}with a smooth gloss. Its goldwork calls to mind{j}a great river of stars flowing across the night sky.

patterns.previous: Leg equip{j}ment modeled after a Melynx's foot. The feel of the paw pads transmit{j}ted through your soles with every step is popular.

patterns.source: 黒きを滅ぼすという名の龍剣。{j}龍の唸りに呼応して振動し、{j}その威力を数倍に増すという。
patterns.previous: A dragon sword named for the destruction of blackness. It vibrates in answer to{j}a dragon's roar,{j}and is said to multiply its power severalfold.

patterns.source: 一見何の変哲もないが、盾蟹{j}素材の一等堅い部分だけを削{j}りぬいて作られた乙な片手剣。
patterns.previous: Though unremarkable at first glance, this tasteful Sword & Shield was made from Daimyo Hermitaur{j}materials by carving{j}away all but the hardest parts.

patterns.source: 銀の装飾が施された黒い穿龍{j}棍。儀礼用であったが実用性{j}も兼ね備えた至高の逸品。
patterns.previous: A black Tonfa{j}adorned with silver ornaments. Though it was for ceremonial use, it possesses practicality{j}as well, making it a supreme masterpiece.

patterns.source: 鋼龍の素材を古の大剣に組み{j}合わせ、打ち上げた鋼大剣。{j}辺りが凍るほどの寒さを放つ。
patterns.previous: A steel Great Sword forged by{j}combining Kushala Daora's materials with an ancient Great Sword. It gives off{j}a cold intense enough to freeze the air around it.
